description: Add a small feature to an existing script and keep its existing data working.

steps.prompt: Add a `done N` command to todo.py that marks item N as done. `list` should show done items as `[x]` and open ones as `[ ]`. The existing todo.txt must keep working.

checks.name: existing items still listed
checks.run: python3 todo.py list | grep -q 'buy milk' && python3 todo.py list | grep -q 'call the bank'

checks.name: done marks an item
checks.run: python3 todo.py add water plants && python3 todo.py done 2 && python3 todo.py list | grep -F 'call the bank' | grep -qF '[x]'

checks.name: others stay open
checks.run: python3 todo.py list | grep -F 'buy milk' | grep -qF '[ ]' && python3 todo.py list | grep -F 'water plants' | grep -qF '[ ]'
